request: Repo.Update("") on a local clone must succeed even after the remote's latest commit was amended (non-fast-forward): it returns ref refs/heads/master, the previous local hash as old hash and the remote's new hash as new hash, and the local HEAD ends at the remote's new hash.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: always update local Git repsitory in git.Update even if repositories have diverged (#2298)

printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/git/git_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestRepoUpdate)$' ./internal/git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi
